title: French Mung Bean Pilaf
description: A comforting French-inspired pilaf dish made with mung beans, loomy, and sproutsukju.
instructions: Rinse the mung beans and soak them in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the mung beans, then transfer them to a saucepan with 4 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the mung beans are tender.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the loomy and cook until it's lightly toasted, about 5 minutes.
Add the sproutsukju and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until it's tender.
Stir in the cooked mung beans, bean, and pilaf.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
